level_id_bank.verdict: NOT HELD. He painted a lot and most of it is fill: three of his bands span single-ladder intervals and two mark places where two ladders agree. The one band that is genuinely his own is the YELLOW WATCH zone at 1,607-1,643, and he drew it AROUND rather than ON the point where the weekly and daily ladders converge to 5 points. Above it sits a 6.1% void, then a second unpainted cross-ladder pair at 1,816-1,871, then the painted convergence at 1,999-2,014. Beneath, the strongest structure is 1,146-1,200, where the daily ladder's own swing high and the weekly's 1.414 meet, and 944-983 where the two ladders hinge.
